title: Configurable publish gate per site
description: A site setting decides whether publishing needs a person's approval (hard gate review request) or may publish on its own. Anth.us: approval required.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged #934: per-site publish approval (required / not_required, default not_required) enforced in publish_item; console Publish counts as a person; approver kind recorded. Next release.
